api.state: kind/settings, current target/mask density/feather/enabled/inverted, next-new flag, subtract, object mode, overlay and availability
api.schemas: Fifteen typed adjustment settings/defaults, nested validation and brush options. Shared native prepared operation, revision/busy/cancellation/revocation guards. Configure changes defaults; edit replace changes an existing adjustment. edit.mask patches density/feather using the same native maskProperties transaction.
api.limits: 4MiB request; 1–4096 stroke points; existing native dab/work bounds. Vision proxy <=8388608 canvas pixels and6000 per side. Object stored mask <=16MP.
